Mishneh Torah, The Sanhedrin and the Pen:
Ketzad malkin et hamechuyyav malkot. kefi kocho shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 2)</small> "kede rishato bemispar". veze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "arbaim" sheen mosifin al haarbaim afillu haya chazak uvari keshimshon. aval pochatin lachallash sheim yakke lachallash makka rabba bevadday hu met. lefichach amru chachamim sheafillu habbari beyoter makkin oto sheloshim vetesha sheim yosif lo achat nimtzet shello hikkahu ella arbaim haruyot lo: 
Kesheomdin et hachote kamma hu yachol lekabbel en omdin ella bemakkot haruyot lehishtallesh. amaduhu sheyyachol lekabbel esrim en omrin yilke esrim veachat kede sheyyihyu yecholin lehishtallesh ella yilke shemone esre. amaduhu lekabbel arbaim vechevan shehitchil lilkot rauhu challash veamru eno yachol lekabbel yoter al ellu hattesha o hashshetem esre shellaka hare ze patur. amaduhu lekabbel shetem esre veachar shellaka rauhu chazak veyachol lekabbel yoter hare ze patur veeno loke yoter al haomed: 
Amaduhu hayyom sheyyilke shetem esre velo hilkuhu ad lemachar vahare hu lemachar yachol lekabbel shemone esre eno loke ella shetem esre. amaduhu sheyyilke lemachar shetem esre velo laka ad yom shelishi vahare hu chazak lekabbel shemone esre loke shemone esre shehare bishat haomed lo amaduhu lilkot ella leachar zeman. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shennitchayyev malkiyyot harebe ben al averot harebe ben al maase echad shechayyavin alav malkiyyot harebe. im amaduhu omed echad loke ufatur veim lav loke umitrappe vechozer veloke. ketzad. nitchayyev shete malkiyyot veamdu sheyyachol hu lekabbel arbaim vechamesh kevan shellaka arbaim vechamesh niftar. aval im amaduhu lemalkut achat vehikkahu shalosh o tesha o sheloshim kemo haomed hare ze mitrappe vechozrin veomdin oto lemalkut sheniyya ad sheyyilke lechol malkiyyot shehu chayyav bahen: 
Mi sheamaduhu ucheshehitchil lilkot nitkalkel mikkoach hahakkaa ben berei ben bememe raglayim en makkin oto yoter shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "venikla achicha leenecha" kevan shennikla patur. aval im nitkalkel min happachad mikkodem hahakkaa afillu nitkalkel mishsheyyatza mibbet din lilkot vaafillu mibbaerev hare ze loke kol haomed sheamaduhu. amaduhu lishte malkiyyot velaka venitkalkel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya patur. nifseka hartzua bashsheniyya potrin oto. nifseka barishona niftar mimmalkot rishona veloke haomed hashsheni: 
Kefatuhu al haammud lilkot vecharat et hametarim uvarach patur veen machazirin oto: 
Kol mi shechata velaka chozer lechashruto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "venikla achicha leenecha" kevan shellaka hare hu achicha. af kol mechuyyeve karet shelaku nifteru mide keritatan: 
Kohen gadol shechata loke bishlosha kishar kol haam vechozer ligdullato: 
Aval rosh hayeshiva shechata malkin oto veeno chozer lisraruto. gam eno chozer lihyot keechad mishshear hassanhedrin. shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin:

Elu hen hallokin. kol haover al lo taase shechayyavin alav karet veen bo mitat bet din kegon ochel chelev vedam vechametz befesach. vechen kol haover al lo taase shechayyavin alav mita bide shamayim kegon ochel tevel vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora. vechen kol haover al lav sheyyesh bo maase kegon ochel basar bechalav o lovesh shaatnez. aval lav sheen bo maase kegon holech rachil venokem venoter venose shema shav eno loke: 
Kol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav chutz minnishba umemer umekallel et chavero beshem. vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din kegon lo tinaf lo taase melacha beshabbat en lokin alav. vechol lav shennittan letashlumin kegon lo tigzol velo tignov en lokin alav. vechol lav shennittak laase kegon lo tikkach haem al habbanim lo techalle peat sadcha en lokin alav ella im lo kiyyem ase shebbahen. vechol lav shebbichlalot en lokin alav. ushear kol hallavin shebbattora lokin alehen: 
E zehu lav shebbichlalot ze lav echad shekkolel inyanim harebe kegon lo tochlu al haddam vechen im neemar lo taase davar peloni ufeloni hoil velo yiched lo lav lechol echad veechad mehen en lokin al kol echad veechad ella im ken chalak otah belavin acherim o neemar mippi hashshemua shennechleku. ketzad. kegon ze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal" eno loke al hanna vehamevushshal shetayim ella achat. uvechadash hu omer <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu" vechayyav al shelashtan shalosh malkiyyot mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze lechallek. hare neemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh kosem kesamim" veaf al pi shekkalal kol hainyanim belav echad hare chalak otam belavin acherim veamar <small>(Vayikra 19 26)</small> "lo tenachashu velo teonenu" melammed shekkol echad mehen belav bifne atzmo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shellaka bevet din al issur karet velaka paam sheniyya al oto karet atzmo kegon sheachal chelev velaka alav veachal chelev paam sheniyya velaka alav im achal paam shelishit en malkin oto ella machnisin oto lechippa vehu makom tzar kefi komato veeno yachol lishkav bo. venotnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz ad sheyyatzeru meav veyichle. veachar kach maachilin oto seorim ad shekkereso nivkaat: 
Mi sheavar al issur karet o mitat bet din vehitru bo vehirkin berosho o shatak velo kibbel alav hateraa. en horgin oto kemo shebbearnu veen malkin oto. chazar veasa kach vehitru bo vehirkin berosho o shatak en memitin oto veen malkin oto. chazar paam shelishit veavar vehitru bo af al pi shehirkin berosho o shatak konsin oto lechippa ad sheyyamut. vechol ellu shello kibbelu alehen hahatraa makkin otan makkat mardut hoil vechatu mikkol makom afillu al issur shel divre sofrim makkin otan makkat mardut: 
Haggonev kele sharet min hammikdash vehamekallel bekosem vehabboel arammit en bet din nizkakin lahen. ella hakkannain pogin bahen vechol shehorgan zacha. vechen kohen sheshshimmesh betuma lo hayu echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din ella pirche kehunna hayu motziin oto chutz laazara ufotzin et mocho bigzirin. gezerat hakkatuv hi sheen memitin bet din velo malkin et haadam behodaat piv ella al pi shenayim edim. veze sheharag yehoshua achan vedavid leger amaleki behodaat pihem horaat shaa hayta o din malchut haya. aval hassanhedrin en memitin velo malkin hammode baavera shemma nitrefa dato bedavar ze. shemma min haamelin mare nefesh hu hamechakkim lamut shettokin hacharavot bevitnam umashlichin atzman meal haggaggot shemma kach ze yavo veyomar davar shello asa kede sheyyehareg uchelalo shel davar gezerat melech hi:

Kol lo taase sheyyesh bo karet veen bo mitat bet din shellokin alehen echad veesrim veellu hen. 1) habba al achoto. 2) habba al achot aviv. 3) habba al achot immo. 4) habba al achot ishto. 5) habba al eshet achiv. 6) habba al eshet achi aviv. 7) habba al hannidda. 8) haochel chelev. 9) haochel dam. 10) haochel chametz befesach. 11) haochel beyom hakkippurim. 12) haose melacha beyom hakkippurim. 13) haochel hannotar. yad) haochel piggul. 15) hattame sheachal besar kodesh. 16) hattame shennichnas laazara. 17) hashshochet kadashim bachutz. 18) hammaale kadashim bachutz. 19) hamefattem et hashshemen. 20) hassach beshemen hammishcha. ka) hamefattem et hakketoret:

Kol mechuyyavin mita bide shamayim shehen belo taase veyesh bahen maase shellokin alehen shemona asar veellu hen. 1) zar sheachal teruma gedola ben tehora ben temea. 2) zar sheachal terumat maaser. 3) zar sheachal bikkurim achar shennichnesu lirushalayim. 4) zar sheachal challa. 5) haochel tevel shello huram mimmennu teruma gedola uterumat maaser. 6) haochel issa shello hurema challatah. 7) kohen tame sheachal teruma tehora. 8) kohen shennichnas lekodesh hakkadashim shello laavoda. 9) kohen sheyyatza min hammikdash bishat avoda. 10) levi sheavad baavodat kohanim. 11) zar sheshshimmesh bammikdash. 12) mechussar begadim hare hu kezar veloke im avad. 13) kohen tame sheshshimmesh. yad) shetuy yayin sheshshimmesh. 15) tevul yom sheshshimmesh. 16) mechussar kippurim sheshshimmesh. 17) perua rosh sheshshimmesh. 18) kerua begadim sheshshimmesh:

melech shehirba kesef vezahav: nimtzeu kol hallokim 207 vesiman lahem yilku zedim:

En bet din onshin beomed haddaat ella al pi edim biraya berura. afillu rauhu haedim rodef achar chavero vehitru bo veheelimu enehem o shennichnesu acharav lechurba venichnesu acharav umetzauhu harug umefarper vehassayif menattef dam beyad hahoreg hoil velo rauhu beet shehikkahu en bet din horgin beedut zo veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "venaki vetzaddik al taharog". vechen im heidu alav shenayim sheavad avoda zara ze raahu sheavad et hachamma vehitra bo veze raahu sheavad et hallevana vehitra bo en mitztarfin. shenneemar venaki vetzaddik al taharog hoil veyesh sham tzad lenakkoto velihyoto tzaddik al taharguhu: 
Kol mi sheasa davar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din beones en bet din memitin oto veaf al pi shehaya metzuvve sheyyehareg veal yaavor af al pi shechillel et hashshem vehu anus eno neherag shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "velannaara lo taase davar" zo azhara levet din shello yaanshu et haanus: 
Ish sheanasuhu ad shebba al haerva chayyav mitat bet din sheen kishshuy ella ledaat. aval haishsha hannivelet beones afillu amra achar shenneensa hanichu lo hare hi petura mippene sheyyitzrah nitgabber aleha: 
Asur levet din lachus al hahoreg shello yomru kevar neherag ze uma toelet yesh baharigat haacher venimtzeu mitrashshelin baharigato. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 13)</small> "velo tachos encha alav uviarta dam hannaki". vechen asur levet din lachus al mi shennitchayyev kenas shello yomru ani hu ze shello bechavvana asa ella magbin mimmennu kol sheyyesh lo belo chanina shenneemar velo tachos encha. vechen bedine mamonot en merachamin al haddal. shello tomar ani hu ze uvaal dino ashir hoil vaani veheashir chayyavin lefarneso azakkennu baddin venimtza mitparnes bechavod. al ze hizhira tora <small>(Shemot 23 3)</small> "vedal lo tehdar berivo". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo tissa fene dal". asur lehadder pene gadol. ketzad. hare shebbau lefanecha shenayim ledin echad chacham gadol veechad hedyot lo takdim lishl bishlomo shel gadol velo tasbir lo panim velo techabbedennu. kede shello yistattemu taanotav shel acher. ella eno nifne leechad mehen ad sheyyiggamer haddin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo tehdar pene gadol". amru chachamim al tomar ashir hu ze ben gedolim hu ze heach avayyeshennu veere bevushato. lechach neemar lo tehdar pene gadol: 
Bau lefanecha shenayim echad kasher veechad rasha al tomar hoil verasha hu vechezkato meshakker vechezkat ze sheeno meshanne bidvaro atte haddin al harasha. al ze neemar <small>(Shemot 23 6)</small> "lo tatte mishpat evyoncha berivo" af al pi shehu evyon bemitzvot lo tatte dino: 
<small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat" ze hameavvet et haddin umezakke et hachayyav umechayyev et hazzakkay. vechen hameanne et haddin umaarich bidvarim berurim kede letzaer echad mibbaale dinim hare ze bichlal avel: 
Haggas libbo behoraa vekofetz vechotech et haddin kodem sheyyachkerehu beno leven atzmo ad sheyyehe lo barur kashshemesh hare ze shote rasha vegas ruach. kach tziuu chachamim <small>(gemara sanhedrin 7 2)</small> "hevu metunin baddin". vechen iyyov hu omer <small>(Iyov 29 16)</small> "veriv lo yadati echkerehu": 
Kol dayyan shebba lefanav din vehitchil ledammoto bedin pasuk shekkevar yada oto veyesh bammedina gadol mimmennu bechachma veeno holech venimlach bo hare ze bichlal harshaim shellibbam gas behoraa. veamru chachamim raa al raa tavo lo shekkol haddevarim vechayyotze bahen miggassut haruach hen hammeviot lide iuut haddin. <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore. <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "vaatzumim kol harugeha" ze shehiggia lehoraa veeno more. vehu sheyyihye haddor tzarich lo. aval im yada sheyyesh lesham rauy lehoraa umana atzmo min hahoraa hare ze meshubbach. vechol hammonea atzmo min haddin monea mimmennu eva vegezel ushevuat shav vehaggas libbo behoraa shote rasha vegas ruach: 
Talmid al yore halacha lifne rabbo ella im ken haya rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot keneged machane yisrael: 
Al tomar shekkol ellu haddevarim bedin sheyyesh bo hotzaat mamon harebe mizze unetinato laze. leolam yehi din elef mane vedin peruta achat shavin beenecha lechol davar: 
En haddayyanin yoshvin ladin bedin pachot mishsheve peruta. veim huzkeku lishve peruta gomrin et dino afillu lefachot mishsheve peruta: 
Kol hammatte mishpat echad miyyisrael over belav echad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat". veim haya ger over bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 17)</small> "lo tatte mishpat ger". veim haya yatom over bishlosha lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 17)</small> "mishpat ger yatom":

Mitzvat ase lishpot hashshofet betzedek shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "betzedek tishpot amitecha". e zehu tzedek hammishpat zo hashevayat shene baale dinin bechol davar. lo yehe echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo katztzer devarecha. velo yasbir panim leechad vidabber lo rakkot veyarea panav leacher vidabber lo kashot: 
Shene baale dinin shehaya echad mehem melubbash begadim yekarim vehashsheni melubbash begadim bezuyin omer lamchubbad o halebishehu kemotcha ad shettadun immo o levosh kemoto ad shettihyu shavin achar kach taamdu baddin: 
Lo yihye echad yoshev veechad omed ella shenehem omdim. veim ratzu bet din lehoshiv et shenehem moshivin. velo yeshev echad lemala veechad lematta ella ze betzad ze. bamme devarim amurim bishat massa umattan. aval bishat gemar din shenehem baamida shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 13)</small> "vayyaamod haam al mshe". vee zehu gemar din ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav. bamme devarim amurim bevaale dinin. aval haedim leolam baamida shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 17)</small> "veamdu shene haanashim": 
Talmid chacham veam haaretz shebbau ledin moshivin et hechacham veomrim leam haaretz shev. im lo yashav en makpidin al kach. velo yakdim hattalmid kesheyyavo ledin veyeshev lifne rabbo kerotze ladun lefanav. veim haya kovea lo zeman likrot uva zemanno muttar: 
Kevar nahagu kol batte dine yisrael meachar haggemara bechol hayeshivot shemmoshivin baale dinin umoshivin haedim kede lesallek hammachaloket. sheen banu koach lehaamid mishpete haddat al tillam: 
Hayu lifne haddayyanim baale din harebe makdimin et din hayyatom ledin haalmana shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 17)</small> "shiftu yatom rivu almana". vedin almana kodem ledin talmid chacham. vedin talmid chacham kodem ledin am haaretz. vedin haishsha kodem ledin haish shebboshet haishsha merubba: 
Asur ledayyan lishmoa divre echad mibbaale dinin kodem sheyyavo chavero o shello bifne chavero. vaafillu davar echad asur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 16)</small> "shamoa ben achechem". vechol hashshomea meechad over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 1)</small> "lo tissa shema shav". uvichlal lav ze azhara limkabbel lashon hara umesapper lashon hara umeid edut sheker. vechen baal din muzhar shello yashmia devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. vegam al ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak": 
Lo yihye haddayyan shomea mippi hatturgeman ella im ken haya makkir leshon baale dinin veshomea taanotehem. veim eno mahir bilshonam kede lehashiv lahem yaamod hatturgeman lehodia otam pesak haddin umee ze taam chayyav ze vezacha ze: 
Tzarich haddayyan lishmoa taanot baale dinin velishnot taanotehen shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 3 23)</small> "vayyomer hammelech zot omeret ze beni hachay uvenech hammet" umetzaddek et haddin belibbo veachar kach chotcho: 
Minnayin laddayyan shello yease melitz lidvarav shel baal din shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak" ella yomar ma shennire lo veyishtok. velo yelammed echad mibbaale dinin taana kelal. afillu hevi ed echad lo yomar lo en mekabbelin ed echad ella yomar lannitan hare ze heid alecha. halevay sheyyode veyomar emet heid. ad sheyyiton hu veyomar ed echad hu veeno neeman alay. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Raa haddayyan zechut leechad mehen uvaal din mevakkesh leamrah veeno yodea lechabber haddevarim. o sheraahu mitztaer lehatztzil atzmo betaanat emet umippene hachema vehakkaas nistallek mimmennu o nishtabbesh mippene hassichlut. hare ze muttar lesaado meat lahavino techillat haddavar mishshum <small>(Mishlei lo 8)</small> "petach picha leillem". vetzarich lehityashshev bedavar ze harebe shello yihye keorche haddayyanin:

Shennayim shebbau lefanecha ledin echad rach veechad kashe. ad shello tishma et divrehem o mishshettishma et divrehem vei atta yodea lehechan haddin note atta rashshay lomar lahem eni nizkak lachem shemma yitchayyev hakkashe venimtza rodef achar haddayyan. aval mishshettishma et divrehem veteda lehechan haddin note i atta rashshay lomar eni nizkak lachem. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "lo taguru mippene ish" shello tomar ish peloni rasha hu shemma yaharog et beni shemma yadlik et gedishi shemma yekatztzetz netiotay. veim haya memunne larabbim chayyav lehizzakek lahem: 
Vechen talmid shehaya yoshev lifne rabbo veraa zechut leani vechova leashir im shatak hare ze over mishshum <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "lo taguru mippene ish" veal ze neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". uminnayin laddayyan shello yoshiv talmid bur lefanav talmud lomar middevar sheker tirchak: 
Uminnayin letalmid sheraa rabbo shettoe baddin shello yomar amtin lo ad sheyyiggamer haddin veesterenu vaavinennu kede sheyyikkare haddin al shemi talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak": 
Mitzva lomar levaale dinim battechilla bedin attem rotzim o bifshara. im ratzu bifshara osin benehen peshara. vechol bet din sheosin peshara tamid hare ze meshubbach vealav neemar <small>(Zecharya 8 16)</small> "mishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem" e zehu mishpat sheyyesh immo shalom heve omer ze bitztzua. vechen bedavid hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 8 15)</small> "vayhi david osho mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo" ezehu mishpat sheyyesh immo tzedaka heve omer zehu bitztzua vehi happeshara. bamme devarim amurim kodem gemar din af al pi sheshshama divrehem veyada lehechan haddin note mitzva livtzoa aval achare sheggamar haddin veamar ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav eno rashshay laasot peshara benehen ella yikkov haddin et hahar: 
Af al pi sheratzu baale haddin bifshara bevet din yesh lahem lachzor velitboa et haddin ad sheyyiknu miyyad shenehem: 
Yafe koach peshara mikkoach haddin sheshshene hedyotot sheddanu en dinehen din veyesh levaale dinin lachzor bahen veim asu peshara vekanu miyyadan en yecholin lachzor bahen: 
Asur leechad min haddayyanim kesheyyetze mibbet din lomar ani hu hamezakke o hamechayyev vachaveray cholkin alay aval ma eese shehem rabbu alay veim amar ken hare hu bichlal holech rachil megalle sod. umaase betalmid echad shehotzi devarim shenneemru bevet hammidrash leachar shetayim veesrim shana vehotziuhu bet din mibbet hammidrash vehichrizu alav ze megalle sod hu: 
Shaal echad mibbaale dinim lichtov lo pesak din kotvin lo kach ba peloni levet din shel peloni im peloni baal dino shetteano bechach veyatza zakkay o chayyav venotnin lo veen mazkirin shem hamezakkin velo shem hamechayyevin ella bet din shel peloni middivrehem nizdakka peloni: 
Kach haya minhagam shel anshe yerushalayim. machnisin baale dinin veshomim divrehem vetaanotehem umachnisim haedim veshomim divrehem. umotziin kol adam lachutz. vehaddayyanim nosim venotnim benehem baddavar vegomrin et haddavar veachar kach machnisin baale dinim vegadol shebbaddayyanim omer ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav kede shello yeda echad mibbaale dinim e ze dayyan hu mi shezzikka oto velo e ze dayyan hu shechiyyevo: 
Dayyan shehu yodea bachavero shehu gazlan o rasha asur lehitztaref immo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". vechach hayu nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin en yoshvin baddin ad sheyyedu im mi hem yoshvim velo chotmim et hashshetar ad sheyyedu mi chotem immahem velo nichnasim lisuda ad sheyyedu mi mesev immahen:

<small>(Devarim 16 19)</small> "lo tikkach shochad" en tzarich lomar leavvet et haddin ella afillu lezakkot et hazzakkay ulechayyev et hachayyav asur veover belo taase. vahare hu bichlal arur lokeach shochad. vechayyav lehachezir hashshochad kesheyyitbaennu hannoten: 
Ucheshem shehallokeach over belo taase kach hannoten. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Kol dayyan sheyyoshev umegaddel maalato kede leharebot sachar lechazzanav ulesofrav hare hu bichlal hannotim achare habbetza. vechen asu bene shemuel ulechach neemar lahem <small>(Shmuel 1 8 3)</small> "vayyittu achare habbatza vayyikchu shochad". velo shochad mamon bilvad ella afillu shochad devarim. umaase bedayyan echad shehaya ole bedugit ketanna laavor bannahar ufashat echad yado vesiyyeo baaliyyato vehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin. umaase beechad sheheevir evra notza shel of meal redid haddayyan veachar kissa rok millifne haddayyan veamar lo hareni pasul lecha ladin. umaase beechad shehevi mattana achat mimmattenot kehunna ledayyan kohen veamar lo pasul ani lecha ladin. umaase bearis echad shel dayyan shehaya mevi lo teenim mittoch sadehu meerev shabbat leerev shabbat paam achat hikdim vehevi bachamishi beshabbat mippene shehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin af al pi shehatteenim mishshel dayyan hoil vehevian shello bizmannam nifsal lo ladin: 
Kol dayyan sheshshaal sheela pasul ladin laze shehishilo. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo laddayyan lehasheil aval haya lo lehasheil kasher shehare gam ze shoel mimmennu: 
Kol dayyan shennotel secharo ladun dinav betelim. vehu shello yihye sachar hannikkar. aval im haya osek bimlachto uvau lefanav shenayim ledin veamar lahen tenu li mi sheyyaase tachtay ad sheadun lachem o tenu li sachar battalati hare ze muttar. vehu sheyyihye haddavar nikkar shehu sechar habbattala bilvad velo yoter. veyittol mishshenehem beshave ze bifne ze. kegon ze muttar: 
Asur laddayyan ladun lemi shehu ohavo af al pi sheeno shoshvino velo reo asher kenafsho velo lemi shessono af al pi sheeno oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato ella tzarich sheyyihyu shene baale dinim shavin beene haddayyanim uvelibbam. veim lo haya makkir et echad mehem velo maasav en lecha dayyan tzedek kamohu: 
Kol shene talmide chachamim shessonim ze et ze asurin leshev baddin ze im ze. sheddavar ze gorem litziat mishpat meukkal. mippene hassina shebbenehen daat kol echad nota listor divre chavero: 
Leolam yire dayyan atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo al tzavvaro vegehinnom petucha lo mittachtav. veyeda et mi hu dan velifne mi hu dan umi atid lehippara mimmennu im nata mikkav haemet shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el". veomer <small>(divrei hayamim 2 19 6)</small> "reu ma attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki laAdonai": 
Kol dayyan sheeno dan din emet laamitto gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael. vechol dayyan shennotel mizze venoten laze shello kaddin hakkadosh baruch hu gove mimmennu nefashot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 23)</small> "vekava et kovehem nafesh". vechol dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto afillu shaa achat keillu tikken et kol haolam kullo vegorem lashshechina shettishre beyisrael shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el". veshemma yomar haddayyan ma li velatztzara hazzot talmud lomar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 19 6)</small> "veimmachem bidvar mishpat". en laddayyan ella ma sheenav root: 
Vlolam yihyu baale dinin lefanecha kirshaim uvechezkat shekkol echad mehen toen sheker vedun lefi ma shettire min haddevarim. uchesheyyippatru millefanecha yihyu beenecha ketzaddikim keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin vedun kol echad mehem lechaf zechut:

Yesh laddayyan ladun bedine mamonot al pi haddevarim sheddato nota lahen shehen emet vehaddavar chazak belibbo shehu ken af al pi sheen sham reaya berura veen tzarich lomar im haya yodea bevadday shehaddavar ken hu shehu dan kefi ma sheyyodea. ketzad. hare shennitchayyev adam shevua bevet din veamar laddayyan adam shehu neeman etzlo vesheddato somechet al devarav shezze haish chashud al hashshevua yesh laddayyan lahafoch hashshevua al shekkenegdo veyishshava veyittol hoil vesamcha dato shel dayyan al divre ze. afillu hayta ishsha o eved neemanim etzlo hoil umatza haddavar chazak venachon belibbo somech alav vedan. veen tzarich lomar im yada hu atzmo shezze chashud. vechen im yatza shetar chov lefanav veamar lo adam shessamach alav afillu ishsha o karov ze parua hu im samcha dato al devarav yesh lo lomar laze lo tippara ella bishvua. o im haya alav shetar chov leacher yitten leze shello nifgam shetaro kelal veyanniach ze shennifgam shetaro bedivre haechad o yashlich hashshetar befanav velo yadun bo kefi ma sheyyire. vechen mi shebba vetaan sheyyesh lo pikkadon etzel peloni shemmet belo tzavvaa venatan simanin muvhakin velo haya ze hattoen ragil lehikkanes bevet ze haish shemmet. im yada haddayyan shezze hammet eno amud lihyot lo chefetz ze vesamcha dato sheen ze hachefetz shel met motzio min hayyorshin venotno leze haamud bo venatan simanim. vechen kol kayyotze baze sheen haddavar masur ella lelibbo shel dayyan lefi ma sheyyerae lo shehu din haemet. im ken lamma hitzricha tora shene edim shebbizman sheyyavou lifne haddayyan shene edim yadun al pi edutan af al pi sheeno yodea im beemet heidu o besheker:

Kol ellu haddevarim hen ikkar haddin. aval mishsherabbu batte dinin sheenan hagunim vaafillu hayu hagunim bemaasehem enan chachamim karauy uvaale bina hiskimu rov batte dine yisrael shello yehappechu shevua ella biraya berura. velo yifgemu shetar veyafsidu chezkato beedut ishsha o pasul vechen bishar kol haddinin velo yadun haddayyan bismichat dato velo bidiato kede shello yomar kol hedyot libbi maamin ledivre ze vedati somechet al ze. vechen en motziin min hayetomim ella biraya berura lo bedaat haddayyan velo beumdan hammet o hattoen. veaf al pi chen im heid adam neeman bedavar mikkol haddevarim venatta daat haddayyan sheemet hu omer mamtin baddin veeno doche eduto venose venoten im baale dinin ad sheyyodu ledivre haed o yaasu peshara o yistallek min haddin:

Uminnayin ledayyan shehu yodea bedin shehu merumme shello yomar echtechennu veyihye hakkolar taluy betzavvere haedim. talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". ketzad yaase. yidrosh bo veyachkor harebe bidrisha uvachakira shel dine nefashot im nire lo lefi dato [sheen bo rammaut chotech et haddin al pi haedut aval im haya libbo nokfo] sheyyesh bo rammaut o sheen dato somechet al divre haedim af al pi sheeno yachol lefaslan o sheddato nota shebbaal din ze rammay uvaal arma vehishshi et haedim af al pi shehem kesherim ulefi tummam heidu veze hattaam o shennire lo mikkelal haddevarim sheyyesh sham devarim acherim mesuttarin veenan rotzim legallotam. kol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen asur lo lachtoch oto haddin ella yesallek atzmo middin ze vidinennu mi shellibbo shalem baddavar. vahare haddevarim mesurim lallev vehakkatuv omer <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "ki hammishpat lelohim hu":

Yesh levet din lehalekot mi sheeno mechuyyav malkot velaharog mi sheeno mechuyyav mita velo laavor al divre tora ella laasot seyag lattora. vechevan sheroim bet din sheppartzu haam baddavar yesh lahen ligdor ulechazzek haddavar kefi ma sheyyerae lahem hakkol horaat shaa lo sheyyikba halacha ledorot. maase vehilku adam shebbaal ishto tachat ilan. umaase beechad sherachav al sus beshabbat bime yevanim veheviuhu levet din usekaluhu. umaase vetala shimon ben shetach shemonim nashim beyom echad beashkelon velo hayu sham kol darche hadderisha vachakira vehahatraa velo beedut berura ella horaat shaa kefi ma sheraa:

Vechen yesh levet din bechol makom uvechol zeman lehalekot adam sheshshemuato raa vehaam merannenim alav shehu over al haarayot vehu sheyyihye kol sheeno posek kemo shebbearnu velo yihyu ellu oyvim yeduim shemmotziin alav shemua raa. vechen mevazzin et ze sheshshemuato raa umecharfin et yoladto befanav:

Vechen yesh laddayyan tamid lehafekir mamon sheyyesh lo bealim umeabbed venoten kefi ma sheyyire ligdor peratzot haddat ulechazzek habbedek o liknos allam ze vahare hu omer beezra <small>(Ezra 10 8)</small> "vechl asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho" mikkan shehefker bet din hefker:

Vechen yesh laddayyan lenaddot ulehacharim mi sheeno ben nidduy kede ligdor peretz kefi ma sheyyerae lo vehashshaa tzericha lechach veyomar shenniddahu vehechrimahu al dato vifarsem cheto barabbim shenneemar <small>(Shoftim 5 23)</small> "oru meroz amar malach Adonai oru aror yshveha ki lo vau leezrat Adonai":

Vechen yesh laddayyan laasot meriva im harauy lariv immo ulekallelo ulehakkoto velitlosh searo ulehashbia belohim beal karcho shello yaase o shello asa. shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 13 25)</small> "vaariv immam vaakallem vaakke mehem anashim vaemretem vaashbiem belohim":
Vechen yesh lo lichpot yadayim veraglayim veleesor bevet haasurim velidchof velischov al haaretz shenneemar <small>(Ezra 7 26)</small> "hen lemot hen lishroshi hen laanash nichsin veleesurin":

Kol ellu haddevarim lefi ma sheyyire haddayyan shezze rauy lechach veshehashshaa tzericha. uvakkol yihyu maasav leshem shamayim veal yihye kevod habberiyyot kal beenav shehare hu doche et lo taase shel divrehem vechol shekken kevod bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hammachazikin betorat haemet sheyyihye zahir shello yaharos kevodam ella lehosif bichvod hammakom bilvad shekkol hamevazze et hattora gufo mechullal al habberiyyot vehamechabbed et hattora gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot. veen kevod hattora ella laasot al pi chukkeha umishpateha:

Asur laadam linhog bisrara al hatztzibbur uvegassut haruach ella baanava veyira. vechol parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim neenash. veeno roe lo ben talmid chacham shenneemar <small>(Iyov 37 24)</small> "lachen yereuhu anashim lo yire kol chachme lev":

Vechen asur lo linhog bahen kallut rosh af al pi shehen amme haaretz. velo yafsia al rashe am hakkodesh. af al pi shehen hedyotot ushefalim bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hem vetzivot hashshem shehotzi meeretz mitzrayim bechoach gadol uveyad chazaka. vesovel torach hatztzibbur umassaan kemoshe rabbenu. shenneemar bo kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek. vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 1 16)</small> "vaatzavve et shoftechem" zo azhara laddayyan sheyyisbol et hatztzibbur <small>(Bamidbar 11 12)</small> "kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek". tze ulemad mimmoshe rabban shel kol hanneviim kevan sheshshelacho hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzrayim veneemar <small>(Shemot 6 13)</small> "vaytzavvem el bene yisrael" amru mippi hakkabbala sheamar lahem lemoshe uleaharon al menat sheyyihyu mekallelim etchem vesoklin etchem baavanim:

Kederech shennitztavva haddayyan linhog bemitzva zo kach nitztauu hatztzibbur linhog kavod baddayyan. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 18)</small> "vaatzavve etchem" zo azhara latztzibbur shettihye emat haddayyan alehen velo yitbazze bifnehem velo yinhog kallut rosh beatzmo:

Kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur asur baasiyyat melacha bifne shelosha kede shello yitbazze bifnehem. im hammelacha barabbim asura alav kal vachomer leechol velishtot ulehishtakker bifne rabbim uvichnisat amme haaretz uvisudat mereut. oy lahem leotan haddayyanim shennahagu bechach meelbon torat moshe shebbizzu dineha vehishpiluha ad eretz vehiggiuha ad afar vegarmu raa lahen velivne benehem baolam hazze velaolam habba:

Asur linhog kallut rosh beshaliach bet din vahare hashshaliach neeman kishnayim leinyan hannidduy. sheim amar peloni hiklani o hikla haddayyan o lo ratza lavo ledin meshammetin oto al piv. aval en kotvin pitcha alav ad sheyyavou shenayim veyaidu alav shennimna lavo levet din:
En shaliach bet din chayyav baamirat devarim mishshum lashon hara. vechol hametzaer shaliach bet din yesh levet din reshut lehakkoto makkat mardut:

Shaliach sheamar peloni shelachani beshem echad min haddayyanim velo ratza baal din lavo en kotvin alav pitcha shel shamta ad sheyyomar mishshem shelashtan. bamme devarim amurim shehalach hashshaliach beyom sheeno yadua lishivat haddayyanim. aval bayyom hayyadua shehaddayyanim yoshvim bo ledin hakkol yodim shekkol haddayyanim mekubbatzin veaf al pi shebba hashshaliach beshem echad keillu ba beshem shelashtan:

Mi sheshshalchu lo bet din lavo velo ba laddin menaddin oto vechotvin alav pitcha venoten sechar hassofer uvaet sheyyavo korin happitcha. katvu lo pitcha mippene shello kibbel haddin kevan sheamar hareni mekabbel haddin korin nidduyo. kavu lo bet din zeman sheyyavo hayyom velo ba kol oto hayyom kotvin alav pitcha laerev. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya bammedina umarad velo ba. aval im haya bakkefarim veyotze venichnas kovim lo zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni. veim shalam yom sheni velo ba en kotvin alav pitcha ad lemachar:

En kovin zeman lo bime nisan velo bime tishre mippene shehaam terudin bemoadot. velo beerev shabbat velo beerev yom tov. aval kovin benisan sheyyavo achar nisan uvetishre sheyyavo achar tishre. aval lo kovin beerev shabbat sheyyavo achar shabbat mippene shehakkol terudin beerev shabbat:

Mi shehu bammedina vehalach shaliach bet din velo metzao en kovin lo zeman ad sheyyimtza oto hashshaliach veyomar lo. haya bichfar chutz lammedina im darko lavo beoto hayyom omer hashshaliach afillu leechad min hashshechenim afillu leishsha im yavo peloni hodiuhu shebbet din kavu lo zeman sheyyavo levet din. veim lo ba menaddin oto laerev. bamme devarim amurim kesheen hadderech sheddarko lelech bah al mekom bet din aval im darko alehen en menaddin oto ad sheyyodio hashshaliach beatzmo shemma lo amru lo hashshechenim. shehare hem omrin darko al petach bet din uchevar halach alehem veniftar. vechen im lo ba bammedina ad lemachar en somchin al hashshechenim shemma shachchu velo amru lo:

Mi shebba levet din vekibbel haddin veamru lo leshallem vehalach velo shillem en menaddin oto ad sheyyatru bo sheni vachamishi vesheni. veachar kach menaddin oto ad sheyyitten ma shehu chayyav. veim amad sheloshim yom velo tava lehattir nidduyo machrimin oto:

Vechen haggonev kilayim habba min hasse umimmin acher o shegganav terefa o kittaat o chiggeret o suma o behemat hashshuttafin vetavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha:

Vechen hattoen taanat aveda befikkadon venishba vechazar vetaan taanat gannav venishba veachar kach bau edim patur min hakkefel shekkevar yatza happikkadon mide habbealim mishshevua rishona: 
Hattoen taanat gannav baaveda venishba veachar kach bau edim shehaaveda birshuto vesheker taan meshallem tashlume kefel shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 8)</small> "al kol aveda". vehu sheyyiton shennigneva belistim mezuyyan shehu anus ufatur. aval im taan shennigneva belo ones patur min hakkefel mippene shehu chayyav leshallem al pi taanato sheshshomer aveda keshomer sachar hu kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon venishba. veachar kach bau edim shehu birshuto. vechazar vetaan bo taanat gannav venishba veachar kach bau edim sheadayin birshuto hu. afillu mea peamim chayyav kefel al kol taana vetaana. veim nishba chamesh peamim nimtza meshallem shishsha hakkeren shehifkid etzlo vachamishsha bekeren mishshum chamishsha kefelot shel chamesh shevuot: 
Taan taanat gannav venishba vechazar vetaan taanat aveda venishba. uvau edim shello nignav vehoda hu shello avad hoil umeshallem tashlume kefel al pi edim eno meshallem chomesh al shevua acharona af al pi shehoda. shehammamon hamechayyevo bechefel potro min hachomesh: 
Masar shoro lishnayim vetaanu taanat gannav venishbeu vehoda echad mehem vehashsheni bau alav edim. shenehen meshallemin et hakkeren. veim tafas baal happikkadon et hakkefel en motziin miyyado. veze shehu meshallem chomesh kishar hannishbain shevuat happikkadon shehodu meatzman: 
Baal happikkadon shettava et hashshomer venishba shennignav veachar kach hukkar haggannav vetava hashshomer et haggannav vehoda lo haggannav shegganav vetava baal happikkadon et haggannav vechafar uvau edim shegganav. im beemet nishba hashshomer keshettaan shennignav niftar haggannav min hakkefel behodaato lashshomer. veim besheker nishba en motziin hakkefel min haggannav. veim tafsu habbealim hakkefel en motziin miyyadan. tavu habbealim et hashshomer veshillem veachar kach hukkar haggannav utevauhu habbealim vehoda lahen shegganav veachar kach tevao hashshomer vechafar bo uvau edim shegganav en motziin hakkefel min haggannav veim tafas hashshomer et hakkefel en motziin miyyado vechen haddin betashlume arbaa vachamishsha im tavach haggannav o machar: 
Hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon shel katan af al pi shennatan lo keshehu katan utevao keshehu gadol venishba veachar kach bau edim hare ze patur min hakkefel shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "ki yitten ish" veen netinat katan kelum vetzarich shettihye netina utevia shavin baggadol: 
Shomer shegganav mershuto kegon shegganav tale meeder shehufkad etzlo vesela mikkis shehufkad etzlo. im yesh alav edim chayyav bechefel. veaf al pi shehechzir hassela limkomo vehattale leedro hare ze chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyodia habbealim. shehare kalta shemirato ucheillu lo hechzir kelum ad sheyyodia bealav. aval haggonev sela mikkis chavero o keli mibbeto vehechzir davar hagganuv mibbeto limkomo im yadu habbealim bignevato velo yadu bachazirato adayin haggannav chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyimne et meotav: 
Mana et kiso umetzao shalem hamminyan patur. veim lo yadu habbealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato afillu minyan eno tzarich ella kevan shehecheziro limkomo niftar meacharayuto: 
Bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim. aval haggonev tale meeder chavero veyadu bo habbealim vehecheziro laeder shello middaat habbealim umet o nignav chayyav beacharayuto. veim manu et hatztzon vehi shelema patur. veim lo yadu habbealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato af al pi shemmanu et hatztzon vehi shelema chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyodia et habbealim kede sheyyishmeru et hattale hagganuv shehare limdo derech acheret chutz midderech shear hatztzon shebbeeder ze:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 5:
Asur liknot min haggannav hachefetz shegganav. veavon gadol hu shehare machazik yede ovre avera vegorem lo lignov genevot acherot sheim lo yimtza lokeach eno gonev veal ze neemar <small>(Mishlei 29 24)</small> "cholek im gannav sone nafsho": 
Haggonev umachar velo nityaashu habbealim veachar kach hukkar haggannav uvau edim shezze hachefetz shemmecharo peloni ze hu genavo befanenu. chozer hachefetz livalav vehabbealim notnin lallokeach damim sheshshakal laggannav mippene takkanat hashshuk. vehabbealim chozrin veosim din im haggannav. veim ganav mefursam hu lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk veen habbealim notnin lallokeach kelum ella chozer hallokeach veose din im haggannav umotzi mimmennu damim sheshshakal lo: 
Nityaashu habbealim min haggeneva ben shennityaashu veachar kach machar haggannav ben shennityaashu achar shemmachar. kana hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut veeno machzir haggeneva atzmah livaleha ella noten lahem haddamim im lakach miggannav mefursam. o eno noten kelal lo chefetz velo damim mippene takkanat hashshuk im lo haya ze hammocher gannav mefursam: 
Bizman shehallokeach ose din im baal habbayit. im en edim bechamma lakach hare hattaggar nishba binkitat chefetz bechamma lakach venotel min habbealim. vechol hannishba venotel shevuato middivrehem venishba binkitat chefetz kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Bizman shehallokeach ose din im haggannav vehu omer bechach vechach lakachti mimmecha vehu omer lo macharti lecha ella befachot mizze. hattaggar nishba binkitat chefetz venotel min haggannav. sheen haggannav yachol lishshava mippene shehu chashud al hashshevua: 
Ganav ufara bechovo ganav ufara behekkefo en baze takkanat hashshuk ella habbealim notlim haggeneva belo damim veyishshaer chov ellu al haggannav keshehaya. mishken haggeneva ben shemmishkenah beyeter al dameha o befachot middameha habbealim notnin levaal hammashkon vechozrin veosin din im haggannav ella im ken haya haggannav mefursam kemo shebbearnu: 
Hallokeach miggannav sheeno mefursam ben shellakach mimmennu sheve mea bematayim o sheve matayim bemea hare ze notel haddamim mibbaal habbayit veachar kach machzir haggeneva mippene takkanat hashshuk kemo shebbearnu: 
Haya noshe begannav mea zuz veganav vehevi levaal chovo venatan lo mea acheret hare haggeneva chozeret livaleha veomrin laze lech uteva haggannav bematayim shello natatta lo hammea haacheret mippene hachefetz shehevi lecha bilvad keshem sheheemanto barishona heemanto baacharona: 
Lakach miggannav sheeno mefursam bemea umachar leacher bemea veesrim vehukkar haggannav. baal haggeneva noten leze haacharon mea veesrim venotel genevato vechozer habbaal venotel esrim shel sachar min hammocher venotel hammea min haggannav. veim gannav mefursam hu notel hammea veesrim min hattaggar shellakach min haggannav veholech hattaggar vetovea haggannav bemea shel keren. vehu haddin im machar hashsheni lishlishi vehashshelishi lirvii afillu mea shehu notel mikkol echad veechad ma shenniskar venotel hakkeren min haggannav. vechol haddevarim haellu lifne yeush kemo shebbearnu: 
Baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor et kelav veyatza lo shem geneva bair vehikkir kelav usefarav beyad acherim. o shehaya asuy limkor vehayu kelim ellu shehikkir mikkelim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. im bau edim shezze kelav shel ze yishshava ze shehen beyado binkitat chefetz bechamma lakach veyittol mibbaal habbayit veyachzir lo kelav: 
Haya baal habbayit asuy limkor et kelav velo hayu middevarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir af al pi sheyyatza lo shem geneva bair vehukkeru kelav eno machaziran miyyad hallakochot shemma hu mecharan laacherim. aval im bau bene adam velanu betoch beto veamad vezaak ballayla nignevu kelay usefaray uvau bene adam umatzu machteret chatura uvene adam shellanu betoch beto yotzin utzerorot shel kelim al kitfehem vehakkol omrim hallalu kelav usefarav shel peloni hare ze neeman. veyishshava ze shehakkelim beyado binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi veyittol mibbaal haggeneva veyachzir lo kelav: 
Ganav shehuchzak venitparsem shennichnas letoch bet chavero veedim meidim sheyyatza vechelim temunim lo tachat kenafav af al pi shehaya sham baal habbayit vetaan veamar lekuchin hen beyadi uvaal habbayit omer genuvim hem. im haya baal habbayit sheen darko limkor et kelav veotam kelim en derech bene adam lehateminan veen derech oto hammuchzak lehatzenia kelav tachat kenafav. hare baal habbayit neeman veyishshava binkitat chefetz venotel kelav. veim en adam ze muchzak bigneva en baal habbayit neeman ella nishba ze shehakkelim beyado shevuat hesset shehakkelim haellu lekuchim beyado veholech:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 6:
Kol davar shechezkato shehu ganuv asur likkach oto. vechen im rov oto haddavar shehu ganuv en lokchin oto. lefichach en lokchim min haroim tzemer o chalav o gedayim. aval lokchin mehen chalav ugevina bammidbar aval lo bayyishshuv. umuttar likkach min haroim arba tzon o arba gizzot shel tzemer meeder katan o chamesh meeder gadol. sheen chezkato shehu ganuv bedavar ze: 
Kelalo shel davar kol sheharoe mochro im haya baal habbayit margish bo muttar lelakcho min haroe. veim en baal habbayit margish bo asur lelakcho: 
En lokchin mishshomre perot etzim o perot ella bizman shehen yoshvin umochrim vehassallim vehappeles lifnehem. shehare haddavar galuy veyesh lo kol veen ze geneva. velokchin mippetach hagginna aval lo meachore hagginna. vechullan sheamru hatemen asur lakachat mehen. umuttar lakachat min haaris shehare yesh lo chelek bapperot uvaetzim: 
En lokchin min hannashim umin haavadim umin hakketannim ella devarim shechezkatan shehen shellahen middaat habbealim. kegon nashim shemmachru kele pishtan baggalil o agalim bashsharon. vechullan sheamru hatemen asur likkach mehen mippene shehen bechezkat geneva. velokchim betzim vetarnegolim bechol makom mikkol adam. veim amar hatemen asur: 
Lokchin min habbaddadin zetim bemidda veshemen bemidda aval lo zetim muatim velo shemen muat shechezkato geneva hem. vechen kol kayyotze bahem: 
Mochin shehakkoves motzi hare ellu shello veshehassorek motzi hare ellu shel baal habbayit. hakkoves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello yeter mikken shel baal habbayit. im haya shachor al gabbe lavan notel et hakkol vehem shello: 
Hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede meshichat machat veshiyyer min habbeged matlit shehi shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot chayyav lehacheziran labbealim. pachot mikkan shello: 
Nesoret shehecharash motzi. bemaatzad shello. bechashshil shel baal habbayit. veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit af hannesoret shel baal habbayit. vechol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen holchin bahen achar minhag hammedina: 
Kol umman shemmachar davar min haddevarim sheeno shello kehilchot hammedina. kegon mochin shemmecharan hassorek bemakom shennahagu sheyyihyu shel baal habbayit. asur likkach mimmennu mippene shehen bechezkat geneva. aval lokchin mimmennu kar male mochin. veim machar haumman devarim shehen shello kehilchot medina lokchin mimmennu. veim amar hatemen asur:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 7:
Hashshokel lachavero mimmishkalot chaserot min hammishkal shehiskimu alav bene otah hammedina. o hammoded bemidda chasera min hammidda shehiskimu aleha. hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura": 
Af al pi shehammoded o hashshokel chaser gonev eno meshallem lo tashlume kefel ella meshallem lo hammidda o hammishkal. veen lokin al lav ze mippene shehu chayyav betashlumin: 
Kol mi shemmashhe beveto o bachanuto midda chasera o mishkal chaser over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 13)</small> "lo yihye lecha bechischa" vegomer. vaafillu laasot hammidda avit shel meme raglayim asur. sheaf al pi sheen ze lokeach umocher bah shemma yavo mi sheeno yodea shehi chasera veyimdod bah. veen lokin al lav ze shehare en bo maase: 
Hayu hammiddot vehammishkalot shel bene hair chatumot bechotam yadua vezo hammidda o hammishkal hachaserim belo chotam. hare ze muttar lashhotam lishar tashmishe habbayit. kayyotze baze sela shennifgema min hatztzad lo yaasenna mishkal ben mishkelotav velo yizrekenna ben gerutotav velo yikkavenna veyitlenna betzavvar beno shemma yavo acher veyaasenna mishkal. ella o yishchok o yachtoch o yakotz o yashlich leyam hammelach: 
Chasra veamda al mechetza yekayyem. amda al pachot mimmechetza o al yeter mimmechetza yakotz ad sheyyaamidenna al mechetza. veim lo chasra ella pachot mishshetut yekayyem laset velatet bah aval lo lemishkal. shekkol pachot mishshetut rov bene adam mochalin bo bemassa uvemattan: 
Sela shennifgema baemtza asur lemachrah leharag o lecharam mippene shemmerammin bah et acherim. aval nokvah vetole otah betzavvar hakkatan: 
Ose adam middotav sea vachatzi sea verova sea. vekav vachatzi kav verova hakkav vachatzi harova usheminit harova. aval lo yaase kabbayim shello titchallef berova hassea shehu kav umechetza. vechen bemiddot hallach ose hin vachatzi hin ushelishit hahin ureviit hahin. velog vachatzi log ureviit usheminit veechad mishshemona bashsheminit. velo asru laasot shelishit hin ureviit hin af al pi shemmitchallefin ze baze hoil vehayu bammikdash mimot moshe rabbenu: 
Echad hannose vehannoten im yisrael o im akkum im madad o shakal bechaser over al lo taase vechayyav lehachezir. vechen asur lehateot et haakkum becheshbon ella yedakdek immo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "vechishshav im konehu" af al pi shehu kavush tachat yadecha. kal vachomer leakkum sheeno kavush tachat yadecha. vahare hu bichlal <small>(Devarim 25 16)</small> "ki toavat Adonai elohecha kol osho elle kol osho avel" mikkol makom: 
Vechen bemiddat hakkarka im hita et chavero bimshichat hakkarka over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda". bammidda zo middat hakkarka. vechen hu inyan pasuk ze lo taasu avel bammishpat lo bemishpat hammishkal velo bemishpat hammidda afillu midda ketanna kimsura: 
Bene chavura hammakpidim ze al ze shehechlifu chelek bechelek o lava mimmennu maachol vehechzir lo. ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan umishshum lovin uforin beyom tov: 
Hammassig gevul reehu vehichnis mittechum chavero betoch techumo afillu melo etzba. im bechazka asa hare ze gazlan. veim hissig basseter hare ze gannav. veim beeretz yisrael hissig haggevul hare ze over bishne lavin belav geneva o belav gezela uvelav <small>(Devarim 19 14)</small> "lo tassig". veen chayyav belav ze ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 14)</small> "benachalatcha asher tinchal": 
Kashe anshan shel middot yeter meanshan shel arayot shezze beno leven hammakom veze beno leven chavero. vechol hakkofer bemitzvat middot kechofer bitziat mitzrayim shehi techillat hatztziuuy. vechol hamekabbel alav mitzvat middot hare ze mode bitziat mitzrayim shehi garma lechol hatztziuuyin:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 8:
Mitzvat ase letzaddek hammoznayim vehammishkalot vehammiddot yafe yafe uledakdek becheshbonan bishat asiyyatan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 36)</small> "mozne tzedek" vegomer. vechen bemiddat hakkarka tzarich ledakdek becheshbon meshichat hakkarka al pi haikkarim hammitbaarim bechitve haggimatriyya. sheafilu melo etzba min hakkarka roin otah keillu hi melea karkom: 
Arba ammot hassemuchin lecharitz mezalzelin bimshichatan vehassemuchim lisfat hannahar en moshchin otan kelal mippene shehen shel bene reshut harabbim: 
Vehammoded et hakkarka lo yamod leechad bimot hachamma uleechad bimot haggeshamim mippene shehachevel mitkatztzer bimot hachamma. lefichach im madad bekane o beshalshelet shel barzel vechayyotze bahem en bechach kelum: 
En osin mishkalot lo shel barzel velo shel oferet velo shel shear mine mattachot kaellu mippene shemmaalin chaluda umitchasserin. aval osin shel tzechiach sela veshel zechuchit veshel even shoham vechayyotze bahen: 
En osin et hammachak lo shel delaat mippene shehu mekel velo shel mattechet mippene shehu machbid. aval osehu shel zayit veshel egozim veshel shikma veshel eshkeroa vechayyotze bahen: 
En osin et hammachak tziddo echad katzar vetziddo echad ave. velo yimchok meat meat mippene shemmafchito lammocher. velo yimchok bevat achat mippene shemmafchito lallokeach: 
En tomnin et hammishkalot bemelach kede sheyyifchatu. velo yartiach bemiddat hallach beet shemmoded. vaafillu hayta hammidda ketanna beyoter. shehare hattora hikpida al hammiddot bechol shehu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "uvammesura" vehi midda achat ketanna mishsheloshim ushelosha belog: 
Mochre ashashiyyot shel barzel vechayyotze bahen tzarich lihyot chute hammoznayim sheochez hashshokel beyado taluy baavir shelosha tefachim ugevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim veorech kene hammoznayim veorech hachutim shenem asar tefach: 
Moznayim shel mochre tzemer veshel mochre zechuchit yihye orech hachutim shehen teluyin bo shene tefachim ugevohin min haaretz shene tefachim vehakkane vehachutin arkan tisha tefachim: 
Moznayim shel chenvani veshel baal habbayit yihye orech hachut shehen teluyim bo tefach ugevohin min haaretz tefach vehakkane vehachutin arkan shishsha tefachim: 
Hachut shettolin bo happeles vechen chut moznayim shel zahav veshel mochre argaman tov arko shalosh etzbaot ugevohin min haaretz shalosh etzbaot veorech happeles veorech hashshalshelaot shello kefi ma shehu rotze: 
Minnayin shechayyav hammocher lehacheria lallokeach beet sheshshokel lo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 15)</small> "even shelema vatzedek yihye lach" amra tora tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo: 
Vechamma belach echad lemea uveyavesh echad learba meot. ketzad. machar lo eser litra lach noten lo gerumin echad measara belitra. veim machar lo esrim litrin yavesh noten lo gerumav echad meesrim belitra. vechen lefi cheshbon ze ben rav ben meat: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shennahagu limkor ayin beayin. aval bemakom shennahagu lehacheria chayyav lehacheria lo tefach: 
Haya shokel lo eser litrin lo yomar lo shekol achat achat vehachera ella shokel lo asara bevat achat vehechrea echad lechullan: 
Makom shennahagu lamod bedakka lo yamod begassa. begassa lo yamod bedakka. limchok lo yigdosh veyosif bedamim. vechen im nahagu ligdosh lo yimchok veyifchot min haddamim. ella moded keminhag hammedina: 
Bene medina sheratzu lehosif al hammiddot o al hammishkalot lo yosifu yeter al shetut. sheim haya hakkav mechil chamishsha vaasauhu mechil shishsha harshut beyadan. yeter al shishsha lo yaasu: 
Hassiton mekanneach et middotav achat lishloshim yom. uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh. vehachenvani mekannechan paamayim beshabbat. umemache mishkelotav paam achat beshabbat umekanneach moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal kede shello yachlidu: 
Hamevakkesh lishkol shelosha revie litra noten litra bechaf moznayim vehabbasar urevia litra bechaf sheniyya sheim atta omer noten chatzi litra urevia litra bechaf achat shemma yippol revia hallitra veen hallokeach roehu: 
Chayyavin bet din lehaamid shotrim bechol medina umedina uvechol pelech ufelech sheyyihyu mechazzerin al hachanuyyot umetzaddekin et hammoznayim veet hammiddot ufoskin hashshearim. vechol mi shennimtza immo mishkal chaser o midda chasera o moznayim mekulkalin yesh lahem reshut lehakkoto kefi kocho ulekanso kefi reot bet din lechazzek haddavar. vechol mi shemmafkia et hashshaar umocher beyoker makkin oto vechofin oto umocher keshaar hashshuk:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 9:
Kol haggonev nefesh adam over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 13)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 16)</small> "lo tignov". pasuk ze haamur baaseret haddevarim hi azhara legonev nefashot. vechen hammochro over belo taase shezze bichlal <small>(Vayikra 25 42)</small> "lo yimmachru mimkeret aved". veen lokin al shene lavin ellu mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav" vegomer umitato bechenek: 
En haggannav chayyav mitat chenek ad sheyyignov et hayyisrael veyachnisenu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo veyimkerennu laacherim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "vehitammer bo umecharo". vaafillu lo nishtammesh bo ella befachot mishsheve peruta kegon shennishan alav o nismach bo af al pi shehannignav yashen hare ze nishtammesh bo: 
Genavo venishtammesh bo umecharo vaadayin hagganuv birshut atzmo velo hichniso haggannav lirshuto patur. genavo vehotzio lirshuto venishtammesh bo velo mecharo o mecharo kodem shennishtammesh bo o nishtammesh bo umecharo leechad mikkerovav shel ganuv kegon shemmecharo leaviv o leachiv hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "gonev nefesh meechav" ad sheyyavdilennu meechav umikkerovav bammechira. vechen im genavo vehu yashen venishtammesh bo keshehu yashen umecharo vaadayin hu yashen hare ze patur: 
Vechen im ganav ishsha umecharah leubbareha bilvad kegon shehitna al hallokeach shezzo hashshifcha li veen lecha ella havveladot hare ze patur: 
Haggonev et beno o et achiv hakkatan vechen haappotroppin shegganvu et hayetomim shehen semuchin etzlam uvaal habbayit shegganav echad mibbene beto hassemuchin al shulchano umelammed tinokot shegganav echad min hakketannim hallomdim etzlo. af al pi shennishtammesh bo umecharo patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 16)</small> "venimtza veyado" perat leellu shehen metzuyin beyadam: 
Echad haggonev et haggadol o haggonev et hakkatan ben yomo shekkalu lo chodashav ben zachar ben nekeva ben shehaya haggannav ish o ishsha hare ellu neheragin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "gonev nefesh" mikkol makom. veechad haggonev et yisrael o shegganav ger o eved meshuchrar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "nefesh meechav" veellu bichlal achenu hen betora uvemitzvot. aval haggonev et haeved o mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur: 
Habba bammachteret ben bayyom ben ballayla en lo damim ella im harago baal habbayit o shear haadam peturin. ureshut yesh lakkol lehargo ben bechol ben beshabbat bechol mita sheyyecholin lahamito shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 1)</small> "en lo damim": 
Veechad habba bammachteret o gannav shennimtza betoch gaggo shel adam o betoch chatzero o betoch karpifo ben bayyom ben ballayla. velamma neemar <small>(Shemot 22 1)</small> "machteret" lefi shedderech rov haggannavim lavo bammachteret ballayla: 
Umippene ma hittira tora damo shel ganav af al pi shebba al iske mamon. lefi shechezkato sheim amad baal habbayit lefanav umenao yahargenu venimtza ze hannichnas levet chavero lignov kerodef achar chavero lehargo. ulefichach yaharog ben shehaya gadol ben shehaya katan ben zachar ben nekeva: 
Haya haddavar barur levaal habbayit shezze haggannav habba alav eno horgo velo ba ella al iske mamon asur lehargo veim harago hare ze horeg nefesh. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 2)</small> "im zarcha hashshemesh alav" im barur lecha haddavar kashemesh sheyyesh lo shalom immecha el tahargehu. lefichach av habba bammachteret al beno eno neherag shevvadday sheeno horgo. aval habben habba al aviv neherag: 
Vechen haggannav shegganav veyatza. o shello ganav umetzao yotze min hammachteret hoil ufana oref veeno rodef yesh lo damim. vechen im hikkifuhu bene adam o edim af al pi sheadayin hu birshut ze shebba alav eno neherag. veen tzarich lomar im ba levet din sheeno neherag: 
Vechen habba bammachteret letoch ginnato o letoch sadehu o letoch haddir vehassahar yesh lo damim. shechezkato shebba al hammamon bilvad lefi sheen rov habbealim metzuyim bimkomot ellu: 
Kol gannav sheyyesh lo damim im nafal alav gal beshabbat mefakkechim alav. veim shavar kelim beviato chayyav betashlumin. aval mi sheen lo damim sheshshavar kelim beviato patur kemo shebbearnu: seliku lehu hilchot geneva besad
Mishneh Torah, Things Forbidden on the A: Mitzvat ase lihyot kol hakkarbanot temimin umuvcharin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22-21)</small> "tamim yihye leratzon" zo mitzvat ase:

Vechol hammakdish behema sheyyesh bah mum legabbe hammizbeach over belo taase veloke al hekdesho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22-20)</small> "kl asher bo mum lo takrivu" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lemakdish baale mumin afillu hikdisho lidme [nesachim] loke shebbizyon kadashim hu:

Hammitkavven lomar shelamim veamar ola ola veamar shelamim lo amar kelum ad sheyyihyu piv velibbo shavim. lefichach hammitkavven lomar al baal mum ola vehikdisho shelamim o shelamim veamar ola af al pi shennitkavven leissur eno loke. mi sheddimma shemmuttar lehakedish baal mum lammizbeach vehikdish hare ze kadosh veeno loke:

Hashshochet baal mum leshem karban loke shehare neemar bevaale mumin <small>(Vayikra 22:22)</small> "lo takrivu elle laAdonai". umippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lashshochet. vechen hazzorek dam baale mumin al hammizbeach loke shehare neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 22-24)</small> "lo takrivu (elle) laAdonai" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lazzorek. vechen hammaktir emure baale mumin al hammizbeach loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:22)</small> "veishshe lo tittenu mehem al hammizbeach" ellu hachalavim. nimtzeta lamed sheim hikdish baal mum ushechato vezarak damo vehiktir emurav loke arba malkiyyot:

Echad baal mum kavua o baal mum over im hikrivo over bechol ellu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17-1)</small> "lo tizbach laAdonai elohecha shor vase asher yihye vo mum". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara levaal mum over. kegon shehaya bivhema garav lach o chazazit im hikrivah loke:
Velo karbenot yisrael bilvad ella af karbenot akkum im hikrivan vehen baale mumin loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:25)</small> "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem mikkol elle":

Hammattil mum bekadashim kegon shessimme eno o kata yado loke shehare neemar bekarban <small>(Vayikra 22-21)</small> "kol mum lo yihye bo". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara shello yitten bo mum. veeno loke ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam shehare haya rauy lekarban ufesalo. aval bazzeman hazze af al pi sheavar belo taase eno loke:
Hetil mum bekadashim uva acher vehetil bah mum acher hashsheni eno loke:

Echad hammetil mum bakkadashim atzman o bitmuratan chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser shehammetil mum bitmuratan eno loke lefi sheenan reuyin lekarban kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. vechen hammetil mum batteshii shel taut asiri eno loke:

Hammakdish baalat mum lammizbeach af al pi shelloke hare zo nitkaddesha vetippade beerech hakkohen vetetze lechullin veyavi bedameha karban. vechen haddin bevehemat kadashim shennafal bah mum. umitzvat ase hi lifdot kadashim shennolad bahen mum veyetzu lechullin veyeachlu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12:15)</small> "rak bechol avvat nafshecha tizbach veachalta vasar". mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkatuv medabber bifsule hammukdashin sheyyippadu. uchevar bearnu baarachin shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27-11)</small> "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmennu karban laAdonai" shehu medabber bevaale mumin shennifdu:

Ma ben baalat mum kavua levaalat mum over. shebbaalat mum kavua im yalda vehi kodesh yippade havvalad veyetze lechullin af al pi shehu tamim kede shello yihye tafel chamur min haikkar. veim nitabbera kodem shettippade veyalda achar pidyon havvalad chullin. veim meta kodem shettippade nifdet achar shettamut. shehare lo chala kedushsha gemura al gufah ella al dameha mippene shehayta baalat mum kavua. aval hammakdish baalat mum over o temima veachar shehikdishah nolad lah mum kavua. im meta kodem shettippade tikkaver kishar hakkadashim hattemimim mippene shehi tzericha haamada vehaaracha kemo shebbearnu baarachin. veim nishchata kodem shettippade hare zo nifdet kol zeman shehi mefarkeset veachar kach teachel. veim yalda yikrav veladah. nitabbera kodem shettippade veyalda achar shennifdet havvalad asur veeno nifde. ella ketzad yaase. samuch lefidyon immo matpis ze havvalad leshem oto hazzevach. lefi sheeno yachol lehakerivo [mikkoach immo] mippene shebba mikkoach kedushsha dechuya:

Kol pesule hammukdashin kesheyyippadu muttar leshochotan beshuk shel tabbachim ulemachran sham velishkol besaram belitra kishar hachullin chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. mippene shemmechiratam bashshuk mosif bidmehen. shear hakkadashim sheddemehen chozrin lahekdesh shehare mevi bidmehem behema acheret mochrin otan bashshuk kechullin. aval habbechor vehammaaser sheen demehem lahekdesh ella neechalin bemuman kemo sheyyitbaer en shochatin otam beshuk shel tabbachim. veen mochrin otam sham. afillu hitpis bechor levedek habbayit eno nishkal belitra velo yimmacher bashshuk sheeno yachol lehatepis ella davar hakkanuy lo kinyan gamur:

Kol hammumin happoslin baadam uvabbehema chamishshim uchevar nimnu:
Veyesh mumin acherim meyuchadin babbehema veenan reuyin lihyot beadam. ushelosha veesrim hem veellu hen. im haya galgal enah agol keshel adam. enah achat gedola keshel egel vehashsheniyya ketanna keshel avvaz. aval im hayta ozen gedola veozen ketanna afillu ketanna ad kefol kasher. im yesh beloven enah yabbelet sheyyesh bah sear. im nikkav haor shebben shene chotameha bammakom hannire. piha dome leshel chazir parus af al pi sheeno mechuddad keshippud:
Chitteha hachitzonot shennikkevu o shennifgemu af al pi shennishar miktzatan o shennigmemu im neekru chitteha happenimiyyot shehare beet sheppotachat piha vetzovachat hen nirin chaserin:
Im nittelu karneha vezichrutan immahen velo nishar mehen kelum. aval nekeva sheyyesh lah karnayim keshera. im nifgam haor shechofe et gid habbehema. im nifgema haerva shel nekeva. im nifgam hazzanav min haetzem aval lo min happerek. im hayta rosh hazzanav mefutztzal lishnayim bishne atzamim. im haya ben chulya lechulya melo etzba basar. im haya hazzanav katzar. vead kamma. bigdi chulya achat mum shetayim kasher. uvetale orech shete chulyot mum. hayta shalosh kasher. zenav haggedi shehaya rach umeduldal dome leshel chazir. im nishbar etzem min hazzanav. aval im nishbar etzem mitztzalotav kasher mippene sheeno begaluy:
Baalat chamesh raglayim o en lah ella shalosh raglayim. im hayta achat meraglav veyadav parsatah agulla keshel chamor af al pi shehi seduka uferusa. im hayta yado o raglo keluta keshel chamor vezehu <small>(Vayikra 22-23)</small> "kalut" haamur battora. im nigmemu telafeha vezichrutan immahen af al pi shennishar mizzichrutan meat karov labbasar: 
Kol mum mishshelosha veshivim mum hammenuyin babbehema poslin otah min hakkarban. veim nafal echad mehem bitmima shehi kodesh tippade vetetze lechullin. chutz mizzaken vechole umezoham sheaf al pi sheeno kasher lekarban eno nifde. ella yihye kayyam veroe ad sheyyivvaled bo mum acher kavua mishshear hammumin veyippade. vechen behemat kadashim shennolad bah mum over enah kereva velo nifdet:
Arbaa mumin ovrim yesh baadam uvabbehema veellu hen. garav lach. chazazit sheenah mitzrit. mayim sheyyordin baayin veenan kevuin. sanvirin sheenan kevuin:
Yesh sham arbaa cholayim acherim im nimtza echad mehem bivhema en makrivin otah. lefi sheenah min hammuvchar vehakkatuv omer <small>(Devarim 12-11)</small> "mivchar nedarecha". veellu hen. mi shebbeloven eno yabbelet sheen bo sear. im nigmemu karnav af al pi shennishar mizzichrutan meat samuch labbasar. im nifgemu chittav happenimiyyot. im haya echad meellu bekadashim lo kerevin velo nifdin. ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum. veim hikrivan yerae li shehurtzu:
Vechen behemat kadashim shenneevda bah avera o shehemita et haadam beed echad o al pi habbealim lo kereva velo nifdet ad sheyyivvaled lah mum kavua:
Behema shennolad bah achat min hatterefiyyot haosrot otah baachila asura legabbe hammizbeach hare hu omer <small>(Malachi 1-8)</small> "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha". veaf al pi sheenah reuya lekarban en podin otah sheen podin et hakkadashim lehaachilan lakkelavim. ella yiru ad sheyyamutu veyikkavru:
Nishchata venimtzet terefa hare zo tetze levet hasserefa. vechen im nimtza echad meevareha happenimiyyin chaser af al pi sheenah terefa kegon shennimtzet bechulya achat o shennittal hattechol hare zo asura lammizbeach vetissaref. lo mippene shehi baalat mum sheen chissaron shebbifnim mum ella mippene sheen makrivin chaser kelal shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28-19)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 28:31)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 29-8)</small> "temimim yihyu lachem". vechol hayyater kechaser lefichach im nimtza sham shalosh kulyot o shene techolim pesula: 
E zo hi sanvirin kevuim kol sheshshaha shemonim yom velo raa. uvodkin oto shalosh peamim beyom shiva veesrim meet shehirgishu bo uveyom arbaa vachamishshim uveyom shemonim. im raa monim lo shemonim meet sheppaska hariyya:
Uvamme yivvada shehammayim kevuin. kesheachla asavim lachim merosh adar ad chatzi nisan veachla achare chen asavim yeveshim elul vachatzi tishre velo nitrappea hare ellu mayim kevuim:
Vechamma tochal measavim ellu hallachim bazzeman hallach vehayeveshim bazzeman hayyavesh. kigrogeret o yoter kodem seudda rishona shel kol yamim bishlosha chodashim ellu. vetzarich shettochal otan bechol yom achar shetiyya. vetihye mutteret bassade beet achila. velo tihye levaddah ella hi uvehema acheret letzavvevt immah. im naasa lah kol ellu velo nitrappet hare ellu kevuin vadday. veim chaser echad mikkol ellu hare ze safek veenah kereva velo nifdet:
Ketzad. achla hallach kemishpato baadar kullo vachatzi nisan veachla acharav hayyavesh kemishpato bachatzi nisan veiyyar shennimtza sheachla bishlosha chodashim al hasseder. o sheachla kigrogeret achar achila o kodem shetiyya o shehayta keshura o shehayta levaddah o shehayta bagginna hassemucha lair velo nitrappet mikkol ellu safek kevuin o ovrim. lefichach im hetil bah mum acher eno loke. achalah kemishpatah bizmanne haachila velo nitrappea hare hi baalat mum kavua:
Yesh baddavar safek im lemafrea hi baalat mum kavua meet shebbau lah hammumim o meet shennityaashu merfuatah. lefichach happode otah kodem shennityaashu merfuatah venehene beoto happidyon achar shennityaashu merfuatah hare ze safek moel veeno mevi karban meila kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

En hammumin poslin baof vechen echad hazzachar veechad hannekeva baof shello neemar <small>(Vayikra 22-19)</small> "tamim zachar" ella bivhema bilvad. bamme devarim amurim bemumin ketannim. aval of sheyyavash gappo o nismet eno o niktea raglo asur legabbe hammizbeach sheen makrivin chaser kelal. vechen im nolad bo achat min hatterefot sheosrin otah baachila hare ze nifsal lekarban:
Torim ketannim pesulin uvene yona gedolim pesulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1:14)</small> "min hattorim o min bene hayyona". techillat hatztzihuv baze uvaze pasul. vead matay yihyu bene yona kesherim kol zeman sheoker kanaf umitmalle mekom ikkaro dam. vehattorim kesherim mishsheyyizhavu:
Hattumtum vehaanderoginus af al pi sheen lecha mum gadol mehen hare hen pesulin lammizbeach midderech acheret lefi shehen safek zachar safek nekeva hare hen kemin acher. uvakkarbanot neemar <small>(Vayikra 1-3)</small> <small>(Vayikra 1-10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4-23)</small> "zachar tamim" u<small>(Vayikra 4-32)</small> "nekeva temima" ad sheyyihye zachar vadday o nekeva vaddait. lefichach af haof shehu tumtum o anderoginus pasul lammizbeach: 
Vechen hakkilayim veyotze dofen umechussar zeman pesulin af al pi sheen bahem mum shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "shor o chesev o ez" ad sheyyihye kol min umin bifne atzmo lo sheyyihye meorav mikkeves veez. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "ki yivvaled" perat leyotze dofen. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "vehaya shivat yamim" perat limchussar zeman. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "tachat immo" perat leyatom shennolad achar shennishchata immo:
Hannidme af al pi sheeno kilayim hare hu pasul lammizbeach. ketzad. rachel sheyyalda kemin ez veez sheyyalda kemin keves. af al pi sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin hoil vehu dome lemin acher pasul kevaal mum kavua sheen lecha mum kavua gadol min hashshinnuy:
Vechen harovea vehannirba vehammuktze laavoda zara vehanneevad af al pi shehen muttarin baachila hare hen pesulin legabbe hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:25)</small> "ki mashchatam bahem" kol sheyyesh bo hashechata pasul. uvaavera hu omer <small>(Bereshit 6:12)</small> "ki hishchit kol basar". uvaavoda zara ketiv <small>(Shemot 32-7)</small> <small>(Devarim 9:12)</small> "ki shichet ammecha". vechen behema veof shehargu et haadam hare hen kerovea o nirba ufesulin lammizbeach: 
Veyerae li sheaf al pi sheen kol happesulin haellu reuyin lammizbeach lekarban im avar vehikrivan eno loke min hattora lefi shello nitparsha azharatan. <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "aval etnan zona umechir" kelev asurin legabbe hammizbeach vehammakriv echad mehen o shenehen keechad loke achat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev". umippene ma loke achat al shenehen mippene shenneemru belav echad: 
Mitzvat ase lehakeriv kol hakkarbanot miyyom hashshemini vahala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze". vechol shivat hayyamim nikra mechussar zeman. veaf al pi shemmechussar zeman pasul im avar vehikrivo eno loke mippene shehu lav habba mikkelal ase velo nirtza hakkarban:
Torim shello higgia zemannan shehen kimchussar zeman bivhema uvene yona sheavar zemannan hakkol kevaal mum vehammakrivan eno loke af al pi shehakkarban pasul velo nirtza:
Hammakdish tumtum veanderoginus uterefa vechilayim veyotze dofen lammizbeach hare ze kemakdish etzim vaavanim. lefi sheen kedushsha chala al gufan vahare hen chullin lechol davar. veyimmachru veyavi bidmehem kol karban sheyyirtze. veenan kevaal mum shebbaal mum yesh bemino karban. aval hammakdish rovea venirba umuktze veneevad veetnan umechir hare ze kemakdish baal mum over. veyiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum kavua veyippadu alav. vechen hammakdish mechussar zeman hare ze kemakdish baal mum over veeno loke kemo shebbearnu:
Nimtzeu kol haissurin lammizbeach hare hen 14 veellu hen. baal mum. vesheeno min hammuvchar. umechussar evar mibbifnim. uterefa. vechilayim. veyotze dofen. verovea. venirba. veshehemit haadam. hanneevad. hammuktze. haetnan. hammechir. mechussar zeman:
Kol haasurin legabbe hammizbeach osrin bechol shehen afillu nitarev echad beribbo nifsad hakkol venifsal lammizbeach. vechullan valdotehen muttarin lammizbeach chutz mivvelad nirbaat veneevedet umuktzet veshehemita et haadam shevveladan asurin lammizbeach kemotan:
Bamme devarim amurim keshenneevda bah avera o shehemita keshehayta meebberet shehare havvalad matzuy immah beet shennifsela vehaya keevar meevareha. aval im nitabbera achar shenneevda bah avera o achar shehemita hare veladah kasher lammizbeach afillu nirbea keshehi mukdeshet veachar kach nitabbera. veen tzarich lomar im nirbea vehi chullin veachar kach hikdishah venitabbera shevveladah muttar. vechen efroach betzat terefa muttar lammizbeach:
Hammishtachave lakkama chitteha muttarin limnachot shehare nishtannu venidmu livladot shel issur mizbeach shehen muttarin. vechen behema sheppittemah becharshine avoda zara mutteret lammizbeach shehare nishtannu:
Lokchin kol hakkarbanot min haakkum veen choshshin lahem lo mishshum rovea venirba velo mishshum muktze veneevad. ad sheyyivvada bevadday shezze nifsal. hare hu omer <small>(Shmuel 1 15-15)</small> "meamaleki hevium asher chamal haam al metav hatztzon vehabbakar lemaan zevoach laAdonai elohecha":

Echad habbehema veechad haof shennirbea o shehemit et haadam o huktza o neevad hakkol pasul legabbe hammizbeach:
Harovea vehannirba veshehemit et haadam im hayu sham shene edim hare habbehema o haof niskalin uvesaran asur bahanaa. veen tzarich lomar beellu shehen asurin legavoah. uvamme amru shehen asurin lammizbeach keshehayu muttarin lehedyot. kegon shehaya sham ed echad bilvad vehabbealim shotkin o al pi habbealim af al pi sheen ed kelal. haya sham ed echad vehabbealim machchishin oto hare ellu muttarin af lammizbeach:
Behema shessachaku bah vehiggichuha ad shehemita et haadam hare zo keshera lammizbeach mippene shehi kaanusa. en habbehema nifselet mishshum rovea o nirba ad sheyyihye haadam shervaah ben tesha shanim veyom echad. ben yisrael ben akkum [ben] eved hoil urevaah adam nifsela. veim haadam hu shennirba min habbehema enah nifselet ad shettihye haishsha hannirbaat bat shalosh shanim veyom echad o yehe haish hannirba ben tesha shanim veyom echad:
Meematay tippasel habbehema o haof mishshum muktze mishsheyyaasu bahen hakkemarim maase. kegon sheyyigzezu otah o yaavdu bah leshem avoda zara. aval bidvarim eno naase muktze sheen hekdesh laavoda zara:
Harovea vehannirba ben shehayta habbehema shello ben shehayta shel chavero ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben lifne hekdeshah ben leachar hekdeshah hare zo asura lammizbeach. aval hammuktze im hi shello vehuktza kodem sheyyakdish nifsal. hiktza shel chavero o shehiktza shello achar shehikdisho hare ze muttar. sheen adam maktze davar sheeno shello:
Hanneevad ben sheavad shello ben shel chavero ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben lifne hekdesh ben leachar hekdesh hare ze asur. veyire ad sheyyippol bo mum kavua veyippade bo kemo shebbearnu. vehanneevad hu vechol ma shealav asurin lammizbeach. shekkol tzippuy neevad asurin bahanaa. aval hammuktze hu asur uma shealav muttar lammizbeach:
Hammishtachave lehar af al pi shehu muttar bahanaa hare avanav asurin lammizbeach. vechen hammishtachave lemayan hannovea beartzo hare memav pesulin lenassech. ashera shebbatla en meviin mimmenna gezarim lammaaracha. vechen hammishtachave livhema keshem shennifsela lammizbeach kach tzemer shellah pasul levigde kehunna. vekarneha pesulin lachatzotzrot veshokeha lachalilin uvene meeha lenimin hakkol pasul:
Kol sheyyesh bo shem laavoda zara lo yease limlechet hakkodesh af al pi shehu muttar bahanaa. e zehu <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "etnan" haomer lezona he lich davar ze bischarech. echad zona kutit o shifcha o yisreelit shehi erva alav o mechayyave lavin. aval happenuya afillu haya kohen etnanah muttar. vechen ishto nidda etnanah muttar af al pi shehi erva:
Nasa achat mechayyave lavin kol sheyyitten lah mechamat beila hare ze etnan veasur. vehazzachur etnano asur. natna haishsha etnan labboel hare ze muttar mishshum etnan:
Haomer lachavero he lecha davar ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi haivri hare ze etnan. vehu sheen lo ishsha uvanim. aval im yesh lo ishsha uvanim hare ze muttar beshifcha kenaanit kemo sheyyitbaer. vehu haddin beomer lezona he lich davar ze vehibbaali lifloni hayyisreeli hare ze etnan:
Pasak im hazzona litten lah tale echad venatan lah harebe afillu natan elef kullan etnan vaasurin lammizbeach. natan lah etnanah velo ba aleha ella amar lah yehi etzlech ad sheavo alayich kesheyyavo aleha yeaser. kadma vehikrivattu kodem sheyyavo aleha kasher [veim hayta chayyevet karban yatza yede chovatah]. vehu sheyyomar lah beet shennatan ematay shetteratzi li keni oto meachshav. aval im lo amar lah ken enah yechola lehakeriv davar sheenah shellah:
Kadma vehikdishattu kodem sheyyavo aleha veachar kach ba aleha hare ze safek im hu etnan hoil uva aleha kodem shettakrivennu. o eno etnan shehare hikdishattu kodem bia. lefichach lo yikkarev veim karav nirtza:
Ba aleha velo natan lah uleachar zeman natan lah afillu achar kamma shanim hare ze etnan. bamme devarim amurim bechutit sheamar lah hibbaali li betale ze sheenah tzericha meshicha. o beyisreelit shehaya hattale bachatzerah veamar lah im lo etten lach maot beyom peloni hare hu shellach. aval im amar lah hibbaali li betale setam uva aleha uleachar zeman shalach lah tale hare ze muttar mishshum etnan:
En asur mishshum etnan umechir ella gufan. lefichach eno chal ella al davar harauy likkarev al gabbe hammizbeach. kegon behema tehora vetorin uvene yona veyayin veshemen vesolet. natan lah maot velakcha bahen karban hare ze kasher:
Natan lah chittim vaasaatan solet. zetim vaasaatan shemen. anavim vaasaatan yayin. hare ellu kesherim shekkevar nishtannu. natan lah behemat kadashim beetnanah lo neesra lammizbeach. vaafillu mana otah al pischo veal chagigato beetnanah lo nifselu hammukdashin shekkevar zacha bahen gavoah mishshaa shehikdishan. vechen im natan lah davar sheeno shello lo pesalo sheen adam oser davar sheeno shello ella im ken nityaashu habbealim. aval im natan lah ofot af al pi shehen mukdashin etnan chal alehem vaasurim umiddivre kabbala hu davar ze:
E ze hu <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "mechir kelev". ze haomer lachavero he lecha tale ze tachat kelev ze. vechen im hechlif kelev bechamma behemot o ofot vechayyotze bahen kullan asurot lammizbeach:
Shene shuttafin shechalku. ze lakach asara telaim veze lakach tisha vechelev echad. sheim hakkelev muttarin. aval haasara shekkenegdo im yesh echad mehem damav kidme hakkelev o yater al deme hakkelev motzio min haasara keneged hakkelev veyihye mechiro usheeran muttarim. veim kol echad veechad mehen damav pechutin middeme hakkelev hare haasara kullan asurim:
Nishtanna hammechir kegon shehechlif kelev bechittim venaasu solet hare ze muttar. etnan kelev umechir zona muttarin. <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "etnan zona umechir kelev" muttarin levedek habbayit shehare hen mishtannin. aval gufan shel etnan lo yease rikkuin labbayit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "lechol neder" lehavi et harikkuim:

Seor udevash asurin legabbe hammizbeach veissuran bechol shehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:11)</small> "ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru" vegomer. veeno chayyav ella im hiktiran im hakkarban o leshem karban. veechad hammaktir atzman o hammaktir taarovot shellahen loke al kol echad mehen bifne atzmo. veim hiktir shenehen keechad eno loke ella achat lefi sheshshenehem neemru belav echad:
Nafal mehem kol shehu bakketoret nifsela. veim hiktir mimmenna bahechol loke. veen haketara pechuta mikkezayit:
Heela seor o devash bifne atzman lammizbeach leshem etzim patur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:12)</small> "veel hammizbeach lo yaalu lereach nichoach". lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshem etzim. afillu hiktir davar sheeno rauy lehaketara bidvash o bisor hoil vehu min hakkarban loke:
